source.title: WCA Community Survey 2022
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are glad to announce the **WCA Community Survey 2022**! 

This survey is an instance for the community to provide feedback on different matters. Your feedback is important for us to define the different areas to develop.

<!-- break -->

Each user has their own unique link to the survey, you can find your link on the main WCA website page [here](https://worldcubeassociation.org) (you have to be logged in to get the link). The survey is anonymous. You are welcome to participate even if you have not attended a competition yet. Please **do not share your link with anyone**! All the responses submitted using the same links, as well as the responses submitted via invalid links, **will be deleted**! 

You are welcome to submit your response until **January 15th 2023 23:59 UTC**. 

If you have any questions or technical issues, do not hesitate to contact the WCA Advisory Council at [advisory@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:advisory@worldcubeassociation.org).

translation.title: 2022 年 WCA 社区问卷
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

**2022 年 WCA 社区问卷**现已开放！

这份问卷让社区成员可以就不同事项提出反馈，帮助我们确定今后需要改进的方向。

每位用户都有自己的专属问卷链接。登录后，可在 [WCA 官网首页](https://worldcubeassociation.org)找到该链接。问卷匿名填写，即使尚未参加过比赛，也欢迎参与。请**不要将自己的链接分享给任何人**！通过同一链接提交的所有答卷，以及通过无效链接提交的答卷，**均会被删除**！

请在 **2023 年 1 月 15 日 23:59 UTC** 前提交答卷。

如有疑问或遇到技术问题，请通过 [advisory@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:advisory@worldcubeassociation.org) 联系 WCA 咨询理事会。
